319
City Council Room
Austin Tex March 26th 73
Called meeting
The Council was called to order by His Honor J. B. Wheeler.
Present: Ald. J. E. Sneed Wm. Brueggerhoff
Ed. Christian Geo. Susemann
J. H. Robinson J. W. Henning
C. A. Scholz
Absent: E. Bremond
His Honor the Mayor announced that the meeting was called to make the necessary appropri-
ation required for the entertainment of General Sheridan and Belknap during their stay in
this City. Whereupon Ald. Sneed offered the following Resolution.
Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin. That the sum of One Thousand
Dollars or as much thereof as may be necessary be and the same is hereby appropriated out
of any money of the City not otherwise appropriated, to be used in the entertainment of
Generals Belknap and Sheridan and the gentlemen comprising the party during their stay in
this City. And that said sum be turned over to the Committee of arrangements of Citizens
appointed by the Mayor to be expended for said purpose. And in case said sum be not in the
City Treasury then the warrants of the City be issued for the amount herein appropriated
On motion of Ald. Robinson the rules were suspended, the resolution passed its second and
third reading, the yeas and nays being called it passed by the following vote.
Yeas. Ald. Sneed Brueggerhoff
" Christian Susemann
" Robinson Scholz
" Henning
Nays none

On motion the Council adjourned until its regular monthly meeting.
Fred Steying
Recorder
